name: Live Collab Editor
description: Start a party and build one level together in real time. Everybody in the party is in the same editor: you see each other's objects, selections and changes instantly.

server.name: Party server
server.description: Address of the party server, for example <cy>play.example.com</c> or <cy>play.example.com:5588</c> (the port is optional, 5588 by default). Everybody in a party has to use the same server. You only set this once. Leave it empty to use the server that is built into this version of the mod.

player-name.name: Your name
player-name.description: The name the other players see. Leave it empty to use your Geometry Dash account name.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Which corner of the editor the round Collab button sits in. <cy>Hidden</c> removes the button, you can still open the window with the shortcut below.

button-size.name: Button size
button-size.description: How big the round Collab button is.

open-key.name: Open Collab window
open-key.description: Shortcut that opens (and closes) the Collab window while you are in the editor.

copy-code-on-start.name: Copy the party code when starting
copy-code-on-start.description: When you start a party, the code to send to your friends is copied to the clipboard automatically.

show-selections.name: Show other players' selections
show-selections.description: Draw a coloured outline and a name tag around the objects the other players have selected.

join-notifications.name: Join and leave notifications
join-notifications.description: Show a short message when somebody enters or leaves your party.

receive-invites.name: Receive invites
receive-invites.description: While you are in the editor and not in a party, stay connected to the party server so friends can invite you by your name. Needs the server and your name to be set.
